entries.text: Why, that little...[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_00

entries.text: What’re you doing out here?![VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_01

entries.text: I’m not talking to you two. You can shove off.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_02

entries.text: Wait, I know you... Aren’t you Arven?\nYou’re enrolled in the humanities track, right?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_01

entries.text: And aren’t you the son of that Pokémon\nresearcher—Professor Sada?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_02a

entries.text: And aren’t you the son of that Pokémon\nresearcher—Professor Turo?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_02b

entries.text: Doesn’t matter who my mom is![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_03a

entries.text: Doesn’t matter who my dad is![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_03b

entries.text: The real issue here is what in the world this\nPokémon is doing out here!\c\nAnd what is with this form it’s in?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_04

entries.text: I met it at the bottom of this cliff...
entries.label: common_0185_select_01

entries.text: It saved me from a tight spot...
entries.label: common_0185_select_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]See, we heard this strange cry, and we tried to
investigate, but [VAR 0x0100(0000)] fell
off
a cliff...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_03

entries.text: That Pokémon saved h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer, but it seems like it\nwore itself out in the process. It got kinda...\r\nslumpy afterward.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_04

entries.text: But you shoulda seen it before! It looked totally\ndifferent—it was unbelievably strong![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_05

entries.text: Well, yeah. As it should be. But it can’t fight\nwhile it’s like this.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_05

entries.text: The form [VAR 0x0101(0001)] takes in battle... That’s its\ntrue form.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_06

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]? Is that this Pokémon’s name?\nHow’d you know it?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_06

entries.text: Agiagias!
entries.label: common_0185_legend_01

entries.text: You can’t go in the lab. It’s locked.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_16

entries.text: I don’t remember ever seeing you around. But\ngiven the uniform...you go to the academy too,\r\ndo you?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_11

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)] isn’t the sort of Pokémon that any\nold Trainer can hope to command. It’s special.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_15

entries.text: Special how? What sort of Pokémon is it?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_16

entries.text: You think you’re up to ordering [VAR 0x0101(0001)]\naround? Then how ’bout I test your worthiness?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_12

entries.text: Heh! Well, look at you—quite the little go-getter![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_17a

entries.text: I’m saying I want to test you. You can’t just leave\nme hanging here![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_17b

entries.text: I’ve been feeling all out of sorts, so I’m gonna\nuse this battle to blast these doldrums away![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_18

entries.text: Wow, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! That was awesome![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_14

entries.text: I guess I wasn’t ever going to stand a chance\nusing some Pokémon I’d only just caught...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_13

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]... Were you going
easy
on
him?
You
could
have
won that.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_15

entries.text: Yeah, you’re in some serious trouble if you can’t\neven beat someone like me.\c\nI’d be worried about my future, if I were you.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_14

entries.text: But if you really think you can take [VAR 0x0101(0001)]\noff my hands for me...you’ll need this.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_07

entries.text: It’s the Poké Ball that brute’s been kept in.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_08

entries.text: [EMPTY 41]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_09

entries.text: So why’d YOU have it?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_13

entries.text: Anyway, that thing’s your problem now, not mine.\nGood luck.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_0185_friend_10

entries.text: What? Oye! Can you not hear me or something?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_07

entries.text: Fine, be that way! But you better actually show\nup for school![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_08

entries.text: What a weirdo...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_09

entries.text: That Arven guy definitely knows more than he’s\nletting on.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_10

entries.text: Next time, he and I are battling! I’m gonna wring\nsome answers outta him![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_11

entries.text: But oh, right—we gotta climb the lighthouse!\nCan’t wait to show you the view of our school![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0185_rival_12
